text: SAFETY RECALL NOTICE - RCL-23-088B MANDATORY SAFETY RECALL NOTICE Recall ID: RCL-23-088B Component: Battery Control Module Firmware Update Affected Vehicles: Series Y / NA & 2023 SUV Model X (AWD Hybrid) Summary of Safety Defect On certain 2023 SUV Model X vehicles, software in the High Voltage Battery Control Module (BCM) may incorrectly calculate cell thermal limits during rapid charging. This may cause false battery disconnect errors or thermal management warnings. Remedy & Service Procedure Flash Battery Control Module software to version v1.0.0 or higher. Perform high voltage isolation test prior to vehicle release. Ensure diagnostic session ID is logged in the compliance audit panel.
